blocks.text: Actress-turned-politician Niña Jose addressed comments about her drastic weight loss, assuring netizens that she is healthy and that her current physique was her goal. Jose said this through a statement released on her Facebook page on Tuesday, Oct. 6, which features a black-and-white photo of her laughing. “Thank you for the engagement guys—kahit nega ‘yung iba, nagulat ako dahil lang sa picture ko pa talaga. Thank you,” she wrote, apparently referring to the reactions and comments about her appearance on her social media posts. She assured, “By the way, wala akong sakit.
